content:
Ravi P.: FYI eu-central canary for search-indexer: chart bumped 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0. We're seeing increased GC pauses during shard rebalancing, p95 latency up. Not many 5xx but timeouts on some long queries.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Canary rollout: search-indexer v1.8.0 -> v1.9.0 (canary 12%). Health: passing=88/100, pod restarts=2 in 15m, canary TTL 00:30.
Nina T.: Chart diff shows new default `jvm.heap: 6g -> 10g` and `rebalancer.threads: 2 -> 6`. Looks like memory tuned upwards. Might be overshooting on canary nodes.
Ravi P.: Options: (1) pin to previous chart/image (rollback/pin), (2) hotpatch values to reduce heap & rebalancer threads for just the canary, (3) bump node pool memory. Leaning to hotpatch so we avoid full rollback.
Ops Lead: Agree hotpatch first. If scheduling / OOMs persist we rollback. Also note: we should create a patch chart 1.9.1 with safer defaults if we promote.
Nina T.: Proposed quick steps:
- lower canary percent 12 -> 6
- override values: `jvm.heap=6g`, `rebalancer.threads=2`, `canary.replicaCount=2`
- command: `helm upgrade search-indexer ./charts/search -n infra --reuse-values --set canary.percent=6 --set jvm.heap=6g --set rebalancer.threads=2 --set canary.replicaCount=2`
- watch `kubectl get pods -lapp=search-indexer-canary -n infra` and `kubectl logs -lapp=search-indexer-canary -n infra --since=10m` for GC/ooms for 20m
Deploy Bot: Canary percent change requires two approvals.
QA Bot: Reminder: update release-notes if we change values in-flight.
Ravi P.: +1 to plan, will monitor traces.
Nina T.: Acknowledged. I'll run helm and post output.
Nina T.: Running...
Nina T.: ```
$ helm upgrade search-indexer ./charts/search -n infra --reuse-values --set canary.percent=6 --set jvm.heap=6g --set rebalancer.threads=2 --set canary.replicaCount=2
Release "search-indexer" has been upgraded. Overrides applied for canary subset.
```
Nina T.: `kubectl rollout status deploy/search-indexer-canary -n infra` -> complete in 38s.
Ravi P.: After 12m p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.0s, GC pause spikes reduced. No new restarts in 18m.
Ops Lead: Node memory stable. Keep canary at 6% for 40m; if stable we should publish chart 1.9.1 with adjusted defaults and call out the change in release notes.
QA Bot: Draft RN blurb: "Hotfix: adjusted runtime defaults for search-indexer to mitigate GC pause regressions observed during shard rebalancing; no image change." Assigned QA verification to Nina.
Nina T.: I'll add a CI smoke test for cache/rebalance path to catch this.
Ravi P.: If things regress we rollback with: `helm rollback search-indexer 8 --wait -n infra`. Opening rollback thread only if we need it. Leaving this thread open until final promote decision.
Ops Lead: Thanks all. Please post final status at `1745501888`.
Nina T.: Will report back at 1745501888 with final canary health.
